name: Content · Video Group
overview: Video results composed from reusable Video Cards: one featured inline result plus an ACF List View, or a shared ACF Horizontal Scroller with source fade and navigation controls.
notes: Configuration is a documented selector over the four visible source compositions, not an invented Figma component axis.

The overview says metadata Below, but the vertical sample actually uses Inline. The implementation follows the visible sample: 648 × 200 hero, 24 px gap, then three 648 × 130.667 rows with 16 px gaps.

Horizontal source Below uses 185.9 × 200 cards, 24 px gaps, and a 1104 px copy-me container (variant sample 1056 px). Overlay uses 284.4 px cards with 200 px media clipped by its 160 px scroller. VRP uses five 192 px cards in 1056 px.

Runtime itemCount 0 restores the source count. An empty title preserves source placeholder copy. selectedIndex -1 leaves the default untouched; non-default state previews the first result until another is selected.

Horizontal Scroller is one reusable ACF-compatible shell shared by video and shorts. Native scroll, arrow navigation, Home/End and keyboard arrows work. The original reference repo has no standalone connected HorizontalScroller implementation; the shell follows its RSOnTop native-scrolling pattern.
Preview is an interactive design state. Video playback and result navigation are optional onActivate integration callbacks; no remote video backend is fabricated.

name: Content · Shorts Group
overview: Nine Short Cards on the shared ACF Horizontal Scroller. The five visible source compositions retain their exact ratio, metadata placement, card width, media height and 16 px spacing.
notes: The page overview calls this 9:16, while every visible group uses 3:4 or 2:3. Only the five visible group configurations are offered here; 9:16 remains a Short Card molecule option.
Below uses 238 px media and a 312 px shell. Overlay uses 200 px media and shell. Card width follows the selected ratio. VRP uses 162 × 216 media and 312 px total height.
The VRP sample is labelled 待优化 (to be optimized) in Figma. Its actual 3:4 / Below structure is retained; Post-preview maps back to VRP-Default because no VRP post-preview source exists.
The copy-me shell is 1104 px wide; variant samples are 1056 px wide. Count, width, items and selection remain public React overrides.

name: Content · Video Magazine Zone

notes: SERP source spans are 6-3-3 (588, 282, 282 px); VRP spans are 5-4-3 (486, 384, 282 px). All column gaps are 24 px, total height 424 px.
The same Hero, Video Card, More videos and Playlist molecules are composed here. The hero keeps its source 200:112 media aspect at the cell width.
Figma has existing component-property errors on the tall Playlist instance. Its visible List view / Tall / Default structure is reused without inventing property definitions.

The source's Overview Code Connect points at an unrelated missing weather-card-wrapper. No compatible component exists in the provided repo, so its visible header and facts are implemented locally with original Figma images and icons.

Overview expansion and source disclosure are local runtime interactions. The source shows a 4 Sources badge but only two logos; the disclosure names only the visible IMDb and Wikipedia sources. No target URLs or missing citations are fabricated.
